decisions.reason: The added drawing file formats do not change the requirement to provide a complete drawing set.
The file-format decision does not alter the bushing geometry, fit, guidance, retention, or hole requirements.
The required 45-degree hole-axis orientation remains unchanged regardless of deliverable format.
The requested CAD and drawing formats do not change any main-shaft geometry attributes.
The format request does not modify the sliding mandrel's arrangement, motion path, holes, or required keyway groove.
Requesting IPT and IDW deliverables does not change ČSN/EN compliance or make the supplied Inventor template mandatory.
The 3D model remains required; message 80 changes its delivery formats, which are independently represented by the source requirement.
The same message separately establishes drawing color treatment, but the file-format modification does not further change that presentation requirement.
Deliverable format changes do not alter the premachining, welding, or post-weld machining sequence.
The requested output formats do not change the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The file-format decision does not change specified materials or the requirement to show them on drawings.
The requested PDF, DWG, DXF, IPT, and IDW formats do not establish or modify any specific dimension or annotation requirement.
